description_en: Queries the network bandwidth monitoring data for accelerated domain names. Data from the last 90 days is supported

kebab_example: aliyun pcdn get-bandwidth-data --biz-region all --isp-name all --platform-type all --business-type all --start-date 2017-05-01 --end-date 2017-05-10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetBandwidthData

parameters.help_en:
The list of domain names to query. You can query multiple domain names at a time. Separate multiple domain names with vertical bars (|).

If you do not specify this parameter, all domain names are queried
parameters.help_zh:
待查询的域名列表。支持批量域名查询，多个域名用竖线（|）分隔。

不传该参数将查询全部
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en:
The region codes. Separate multiple region codes with vertical bars (|). To query all regions, set this parameter to all.

For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/151572.html
parameters.help_zh:
地域代码，多个用竖线（|）分隔，全部填all。

查询请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/151572.html
parameters.name: region

parameters.help_en:
The ISP codes. Separate multiple ISP codes with vertical bars (|). To query all ISPs, set this parameter to all.

For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/151572.html
parameters.help_zh:
运营商代码，多个用竖线（|）分隔，全部填all。

查询请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/151572.html
parameters.name: isp_name

parameters.help_en:
The terminal codes. Separate multiple terminal codes with vertical bars (|). To query all terminals, set this parameter to all.

For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/151572.html
parameters.help_zh:
终端代码，多个用竖线（|）分隔，全部填all。

查询请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/151572.html
parameters.name: platform_type

parameters.help_en:
The business types. Separate multiple business types with vertical bars (|). Valid values:
live: Live streaming.
download: Large file download.
vod: Video on demand.
all: All business types
parameters.help_zh:
业务类型，多个用竖线（|）分隔。取值：
live：直播流媒体。
download：大文件下载。
vod：视视频点播。
all：全部业务类型
parameters.name: business_type

parameters.help_en: The start time. Specify the time in the YYYY-MM-DD format
parameters.name: start_date

parameters.help_en: The end time. Specify the time in the YYYY-MM-DD format
parameters.name: end_date
